Rends enemies in a cone toward the nearest foe. On kill, 5% chance to heal 1 HP.
Spits venomous projectiles that bounce between enemies
Launches fireballs that burn monsters
Sprays a stream of flames that swivels toward the nearest enemy and may burn everything it sweeps across
Throws a stick that slows down, turns around and flies back. It hits on the way out and back.
Summons electric shocks on nearby enemies
Every 3 s deploys an octo sentry that lives 5 s and shoots nearby enemies using your stats.
Fires piercing shots that go through enemies in a line. Aim with the mouse or right stick
Leaves stink clouds in your wake as you move. They hit whoever is inside and may poison them; the poison stacks without limit.
Slashes an arc at the nearest foe. Every 3rd swing spins 360° with +100% crit chance.
Blows wind gusts that chase enemies. Gusts fired in midair deal double damage.
Your skin hardens like rock: gain armor that reduces damage taken
Increases attack speed

Increases critical hit damage

Increases the chance to dodge enemy attacks
Extends the duration of the effects you cause
Gain more experience per enemy
Increases the gold dropped by enemies

You steal life from your enemies: every direct hit heals you. Every 100% life steal = 1 health per hit.
Increases the chance of higher rarity rewards
Attracts experience orbs from farther away
Increases maximum health
Increases movement speed
Your projectiles fly faster and travel farther
Your weapons fire more projectiles. Does not affect Razor Fur, Flamethrower or Toxic Stench.
Recover a percentage of your max health every second
Gain a blue shield that absorbs damage and regenerates when you avoid hits
Increases the chance to apply status effects; above 100% it applies extra stacks
Increases damage to enemies with an active status effect
Your fur bristles with spikes: enemies that touch you lose part of their max health. Bosses, with tougher hides, only lose a tenth as much.
Makes your weapons and projectiles bigger
After 10s without taking damage regenerate 1% max HP/s. Each stack adds +1%.
On kill 1% chance per stack to drop food that heals 5% of your max HP.
While airborne you deal 15% more damage. Stacks with each copy.
Each stack grants +5% dodge chance up to a maximum of 95%.
While at full HP deal 20% more damage. Each stack adds another 20%.
Each stack increases your damage against elites and bosses by 25%.
+10% critical hit chance (x2 damage). Stacks with each pickup.
After 3s without taking damage a shield forms that fully absorbs the next hit.
On hit 4% chance to apply bleed: deals 100% of the hit's damage over 2s per stack. At 5 bleeds it bursts, dealing the remaining damage at once.
Grants +1 extra jump. Stacks with each pickup.
+20% damage to enemies above 90% HP. Stacks with each pickup.
+25% gold gain. Stacks with each pickup.
On hit 3% chance to trigger an explosion dealing 80% of your damage in an area around the enemy.
On hit 5% chance to knock back the enemy. Does not affect bosses.
Each stack reduces your dash cooldown by 15%.
+10% chance to open chests for free (diminishing returns). A free chest does not raise the price of the next one.
Each stack increases your attack speed by 10%.
Each stack increases your movement speed by 15%.
On kill permanently gain 5 max HP. Each stack raises the cap by 100 extra HP.
Continuously lose 1% max HP per second but your total damage is doubled.
Your attacks have a 10% chance to stun the hit enemy. Does not affect bosses.

Kill 20 enemies in a row without taking damage to summon an ice blizzard where you stand that damages enemies for 5s. Its size grows with your weapon size, with diminishing returns. Taking damage resets the counter.
On elite kill enter Frenzy for 4s: +50% attack speed and +100% movement speed.
Gain 1% damage for every 1% of missing health. Each stack adds another 1%.
Enemies affected by any status effect take 60% more damage per stack.
On kill launch 2 magic missiles that home in on enemies and explode on impact or when their lifetime ends.
On elite kill your total damage is doubled for 4 seconds.
Your weapons gain +1 Quantity. Stacks with each pickup.
Every 20 seconds sucks up every experience orb on the map. Each stack reduces the time by 3 seconds (minimum 8).
Kill 20 enemies in under 5 seconds to activate Disco Mode: each kill launches a CD from your position toward a random enemy.
Every 100 kills charge the crystal. Once charged, if your HP drops below 50% it bursts and heals 30% of your max HP (at most once every 20s). More copies charge it faster.
All your healing is twice as effective. Each stack doubles the effect again.
Once per run upon reaching 0 HP revive with 15% max HP and 5 seconds of invulnerability.
On-hit chance effects from your items roll 1 extra time. Each stack adds another roll, up to 3.
Whenever you heal a magic skull is automatically launched dealing 250% of the healed amount as damage.
Each consecutive hit on the same enemy adds +0.1% bonus damage per stack. Limit: +200%, and each extra stack adds another +200%. Hitting a different enemy resets the count.
On kill 7% chance to summon an allied carnivorous plant that attacks nearby enemies for 30 seconds.
Critical hits increase your attack speed by 10% for 2s up to a maximum of 30%.
On hit 20% chance to slow the enemy by 40% for 1 second. Does not affect bosses.
While airborne take 20% less damage per stack up to a maximum of 80%.
Grants +1 dash charge. Stacks with each copy up to a maximum of 4 charges.
On hit 5% chance to chain lightning between nearby enemies.
Grants +10% lifesteal per stack.
Taking damage releases a shock that hits nearby enemies for 10% of your max HP. Each stack adds +5% and radius. 1s cooldown.
On kill 5% chance to summon a will-o-wisp that deals 40 damage/s for 5 seconds.
Enemies, elites included, at or below 5% HP are instantly killed by any hit. Does not affect bosses.
On hit 10% chance to launch a rubber ball that automatically chases enemies.
Landing from a high fall slams the ground and damages nearby enemies. Higher falls deal more damage (up to x4). Each stack adds +100% damage and radius.
Unlocks an extra slot to carry one more weapon (max 2).
Unlocks an extra slot to carry one more animal instinct (max 2).

+8% movement speed per level.
+0.25 starting luck per level.
+8% experience gained per level.
Increases the chance common enemies drop rubies and the amount dropped by elites and bosses.
Revive once on death (max 2).
Reroll your level-up options (1 charge per level).
Discard a weapon or instinct from the pool for the run (1 charge per level).
Discard an item when opening a chest for the run (1 charge per level).
Lets you turn off purchased weapons, instincts and items so they don't show up in your runs. Starting content can't be turned off.
The Formless Horror Flying horror that teleports around you and charges straight through. Read the tell before the dash.
Daughter of the Void Predicts where you are going to dodge and drops her hand spell right there, followed by a spread of four projectiles.
Herald of the Abyss Teleports around the arena and cycles dark flames, a laser and tentacles that rise from the ground.
Appears if you accept the Ghost Capybara's request and destroy the obelisks. Defeating it starts the C-Rex unlock chain.
Singer of the Deep Woods A flying whale that leaves a cloud of dust which makes nearby enemies stronger, fires a telegraphed dart and charges a slow energy ball.
Reaper of the Moss A giant mantis that cycles three attacks: thrusts up close, a leaping slam marked on the ground and a cone of three blades.
The Swamp Glutton A huge carnivorous plant that roots itself near you. Spore rings that poison, acid rain and a slow homing acid ball.
Messenger of the Last Breath Teleports to a platform in view every few seconds, slashes, fires a dark wave and drops portal hands right where you stand.
The Bone Mill A rolling wheel of bones. A burst of five ghost dashes, and a belly flop that falls from the sky on the mark under your feet.
The One No One Escapes Throws its scythe like a boomerang from above and below, dives at you and raises skeleton archers.
Comes through the pink door once you return the torn banners. Defeating it starts the Skelly-san unlock chain.
King of the Ice Age A giant dinosaur that freezes mid-air before a belly slam, crosses the room in a ghost dash and calls flags that rain balls from the sky.
Emperor of the Glacier A penguin in sunglasses: jumping pecks, ice blocks that fall in sequence and a sweeping beam.
Sorceress of the Frozen Tides A flying sorceress with five spells: rising bubbles, a water explosion, heads from the ground, ice walls that close in and falling spikes.
Terror of the Peaks Arrives when you try to free the frozen climber in the snow. Snowballs in an arc and a jump that raises a wave of ice.
The Masterless Blade A three-slash combo with a dash on each cut and a leaping strike. At half health it shouts, ignites its sword and gets faster and tougher.
The Stone Puppet A floating stone puppet whose closed eyes reveal the next spell: closing rock walls, pillars where you stand or crystal fists from above.
The Desert Axe A giant goblin with an axe: heavy combos, stomps that send earth eruptions forward, leaping slams and a five-second tornado.
Lord of Ash Plants itself and breathes a huge frontal flame, raises fire tornadoes around you and charges an explosion overhead.
Living Black Fire Starts as a bouncing slime with its own health bar. Then it transforms into a demon with a cleaver, triple jumps and black fire.

The Salamander Witch A salamander witch that sprints across the room casting black holes, fire tornadoes and fireballs. Every few spells her salamander becomes a dragon and fires a beam that crosses the whole level.
Waits in a sealed room after floor 3, shielded by blood hearts you must stand on. Steals your items and returns them as you hurt it. Charges, mouth lasers and zigzag tackles.
Arrives when the Devourer falls. More hearts, double lasers, and she can birth smaller devourers. Defeating her completes the First 300 Floors.

A dark knight with two health bars who steals your weapons and gives them back as you fight. Every attack has a physical version and, after the transformation, an explosive one. Vigil flames keep it shielded.

The one who summons every boss of The Summit, one every two minutes. Fights from the organ at the end of each level with cages of light, pulses and lasers, then retreats through a portal. Waits on the throne at the top.
Flying chaser. Passes through walls, hurts on contact.
Ground ranged enemy. Stops at a distance and shoots.
Flying dasher. Idles, then lunges past you.
Flying kamikaze. Counts 3, 2, 1 and explodes in an area.
Walks the platforms and casts a projectile every few seconds.
Fast melee cultist.
Slow, heavy melee cultist.
Melee chaser that throws itself at you like a projectile.
Hops around and hits you with its tongue from a distance.
Flying chaser. Hurts on contact.
Flying dasher.
Approaches flying, then fires itself as a straight, accelerating dart.
Poison kamikaze. Grows, turns green and bursts into poison.
Ranged caster in four colours.
The minute 5 event: carnivorous vines rise across the tower.
Melee with a thrust and a short dash. Attacks from further than it looks.
Heavy melee: two slashes, each with a long dash.
Tank kamikaze that runs at your face and bursts, even if you kill it first.
Flying chaser that bites with a short lunge.
Charges the spot where you were when it started, and claws when close.
Ranged flyer that never chases. Comes in squads of five.
Patrols a fixed height. If it sees you and survives five seconds, it triggers the Eye Swarm: red lanes full of eyes crossing the tower.
Heavy melee with two different attacks.
Agile melee with a crescent slash.
Flying chaser.
Fast flying chaser.
Ranged flyer that keeps its distance and fires bolts.
Sleeps under a spell until you get close. Only appears in a side quest.
Fast melee with a sickle slash.
Heavy katana slash.
Flying chaser.
Bites and flees, bites and flees.
Ranged flyer that fires stone bolts.
Glows red and releases a shockwave. Does not die doing it.
Drives its greatsword down and follows with a long thrust.
Plants itself and fires a cursed beam in front of it.
Leaps to where you stood and splashes fire.
Flying chaser.
Flying caster that alternates fireballs and dives.
Floating mine that glows redder and redder until it explodes.
One per minute. Hovers above you and breathes fire down.
The only enemy of the Horde (after minute 10), tinted with the colour of the current level.
Pops out of the ground every few minutes and runs. Every hit drops gold or rubies; killing it makes it burst with the rest.
Challenge enemy of the Challenge Statues on stone and snow. Falls from a beam of light.
Challenge enemy on moss and desert. Claws and throws water balls in an arc.
Challenge enemy on blood and volcano. Tackles you from far away.
